# Keep a Changelog-style guidance (quick)

If the repo maintains a human-facing `CHANGELOG.md`, common best practices include:
- Keep an **Unreleased** section at the top to collect changes as they land.
- At release time, move those entries under a version heading with a date.
- Group entries by change type (Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security).
- Avoid raw git logs; write in user terms.
